name: open-rummy
description: Malaysian Mahjong Rummy (拉米麻将 / LAMI) - 3D anime browser game with bots and online rooms

scripts.build: npm run build -w @open-rummy/client && npm run build -w @open-rummy/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @open-rummy/shared && npm run test -w @open-rummy/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/client
